s1.quote: The wreck of Admiral Nakhimov lies on its starboard side in 150 feet (46 m) of water in Tsemes Bay off Novorossiysk.

s2.quote: located exactly at the point where the Admiral Nakhimov passenger vessel sank at a depth of 47 meters

summary.text: The Soviet liner that sank after a 1986 collision lies on her starboard side at about 46-47 m in Tsemes Bay off Novorossiysk. It is a deep wreck and a memorial to the 423 people who died.

s1.quote: The wreck of the Agnes Blaikie was discovered lying in 84 metres (276 ft) of water in September 2003
Russian divers rediscovered the wreck at a depth of 30 meters (98 feet)
